discovery.limitation: One current provider listing, not an immutable historical execution ledger. Deleted runs and expired artifacts remain outside it. Provider totals and absent pagination do not establish response-evidence completeness.

originalReceiptScope.runIdentity: Verify repository id, workflow path, immutable head SHA, actual run attempt and producer job before accepting any response.

frozenArtifacts.name: agent
frozenArtifacts.retention: GH_AW_DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_DAYS or 0; actual retention and expiry must come from the provider.

originalReceiptScope.matching: Bind each original HTTP GET tool request and response to the immutable inventory and resolved URL at that run's head. Keep retries/attempts and captures distinct.
safeguards: Agent narrative, PR status table, successful run and screenshot do not substitute for an original independently attributable response.
Preserve original command and stdout/stderr, raw event bytes, timestamps, immutable artifact identity, provider digest and producer binding.
Retain ancillary documentation responses and all attempted editor endpoints even when outside the three-editor constrained facet.
Source-defined curl GET does not follow redirects; redirected 200 responses cannot replace the original URL's actual status.
Classify expired or absent artifacts as missing instrumentation; distinguish reliable recorded connection failures from collector/setup failures.
No original HTTP data has been acquired by this offline investigator.

gates: Request a new coordinated slot before any further acquisition; no automatic pagination or artifact download.
Bind actual attempts and producer jobs to returned run ID, repository ID, workflow path and immutable head SHA.
Artifact listing establishes exact IDs, hashes and expiration before any artifact-byte acquisition is proposed.
Only original tool request/response pairs with actual URL, timestamp and captured status can establish reachability.
Do not count run success/failure as editor availability or missing artifacts as editor failure.

predecessor.interpretation: Entire previous closure preserved through the existing lossless partition codec before this request.
